record.label: Exposure-trained own-rollout residual state
record.summary: The frozen 6,688-parameter H64 own-rollout model is finite at autonomous development final MSE 3.4709697955756664e-8: 9.14% better than the established ~3.82e-8 family, but 0.90% above its preregistered <3.44e-8 primary gate and above the <1e-8 stretch gate. Same-checkpoint teacher-forced MSE is 8.207963477637236e-9, leaving a 4.23x autonomous gap. Configuration was frozen before loading observer_fit 0..199; ranks 160..199 were already development-open and materialized at startup, metrics were read only after epoch 16, and no observer_selection or rank>=200 target was accessed.
record.terminal_criterion: Closed for this exact H64 exposure schedule because finite autonomous development MSE 3.4709697955756664e-8 missed the preregistered <3.44e-8 gate; broader autonomous-state successors remain open.
